subject.title: fix(ui): keep chat run status in one assistant turn

question: After independent visual proof is attached and required checks finish, should the UI owner accept the protected chat-status ownership behavior on this PR?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and proof of the browser presentation is not currently inspectable from the supplied context.

options.title: Review with attached visual proof
options.body: Require a redacted after-fix browser artifact that visibly shows the single-turn Working state, then review the focused status-ownership behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause for a narrower reproduction
options.body: Keep the PR open if the visual artifact exposes an ordering or fallback case that needs a more focused fix before acceptance.
